scripts.setup:dev:
npm run install:all && npm run docs:build:markdown && echo '
✅ Dependencies installed
✅ Default configuration ready

Run: npm run dev
Then open http://localhost:3000 to configure your AI providers.'
scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development WORKERS=1 concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm run server" "sleep 2 && npm run client"
scripts.server: cd server && cross-env WORKERS=1 node -r dotenv/config server.js dotenv_config_path=../.env
scripts.start: cd server && node -r dotenv/config server.js dotenv_config_path=../.env
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.clean: npm run build:clean && rm -rf node_modules client/node_modules server/node_modules
scripts.clean:install: npm run clean && npm run install:all
scripts.logs: tail -f server/server.log 2>/dev/null || echo 'No server log found'
scripts.extension:build: cd client && npx vite build && cd .. && rm -rf browser-extension/extension browser-extension/assets && cp -r client/dist/extension browser-extension/extension && cp -r client/dist/assets browser-extension/assets && echo '\n✅ Built. Load chrome://extensions → Developer mode → Load unpacked → select browser-extension/'
scripts.prod:build: npm run build && npm run build:package
scripts.prod:deploy: npm run prod:build && npm run start:prod
scripts.build: npm run build:no-docs && npm run docs:build:all && npm run docs:copy:all
scripts.build:no-docs: npm run build:clean && npm run build:client && npm run build:extension && npm run build:server && npm run build:shared && npm run build:config && npm run build:releases
scripts.build:client: cd client && npm run build && mkdir -p ../dist/public && cp -r dist/* ../dist/public/
scripts.build:extension: mkdir -p dist/browser-extension && cp -r browser-extension/manifest.json browser-extension/background.js browser-extension/icons dist/browser-extension/
scripts.build:server: npm run docs:build:markdown && mkdir -p dist/server && cp -r server/* dist/server/ && rm -rf dist/server/node_modules && node scripts/build-api-docs.js dist/server/generated/openapi
scripts.build:releases: mkdir -p dist/docs/releases && cp -r docs/releases/* dist/docs/releases/ && cp docs/*.md dist/docs/ && cp -r docs/assets dist/docs/
scripts.build:config: cp package.json package-lock.json dist/ && npm run build:dotenv
scripts.build:dotenv: [ -f .env ] && cp .env dist/ || echo 'No .env file found, skipping'
scripts.build:package: cd dist && npm ci --omit=dev && cd server && npm ci --omit=dev
scripts.build:docker: npm run build:no-docs && npm run build:package
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:update-version && cd docs && mdbook build
scripts.docs:build:all: npm run docs:update-version && npm run docs:build && npm run docs:build:markdown
scripts.docs:copy:all: mkdir -p dist/exports && (cp docs/book/pdf/*.pdf dist/exports/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp docs/book/iHub-Apps-Documentation.md dist/exports/ 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.docker:clean: docker system prune -f && docker volume prune -f
scripts.docker:clean:all: docker system prune -af && docker volume prune -f
scripts.test:all: npm run test:quick && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:quick: npm run lint:config-access && npm run test:unit && npm run test:server && npm run test:token-stats && npm run test:export-formats && npm run test:feature-flags
scripts.test:e2e:voice: cross-env VOICE_E2E=1 playwright test --config tests/config/playwright.config.js tests/e2e/voice-mode.spec.js --project=chromium
scripts.test:smoke: npm run test:adapters && npm run test:boot
scripts.lint-format:fix: npm run lint:fix && npm run format:fix
